# DCSI, Inc. — "Security & Sound"

> DCSI, Inc. is a full-service security and sound company in Lutz, Florida, serving
> Hillsborough and Pasco Counties in the Tampa Bay area. Founded in 2004, DCSI
> designs, installs, and monitors residential and commercial alarm systems, CCTV
> camera systems, gate and access control, home theater and whole-home audio, and
> structured wiring. Alarm monitoring is handled in house rather than outsourced
> to a third-party call center.

## Key facts

- Legal name: DCSI, Inc.
- Address: 128 W. Lutz Lake Fern Rd, Lutz, FL 33548, United States
- Phone: (813) 949-6500
- Fax: (813) 949-6599
- Email: info@dcsisecurity.com
- Founded: 2004
- Service area: Hillsborough and Pasco Counties, Florida (plus parts of Pinellas).
  The Lutz office sits on the Hillsborough/Pasco county line. Core markets: Lutz,
  Wesley Chapel, Land O' Lakes, Odessa, Carrollwood, New Tampa, Westchase, and
  Brandon. Also serving Tampa, Trinity, Riverview, Temple Terrace, Town 'n'
  Country, and Zephyrhills.
- Monitoring: 24/7, in house
- Consultations and quotes: free, no obligation
- Warranty: 90 days on labor, 1 year on parts; extended warranties and service
  contracts available

## Services

- [Security systems & 24/7 monitoring](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/security-monitoring):
  Custom residential and commercial burglar alarm systems, silent alarms, medical
  and panic alerts, fire systems, home automation, and in-house 24/7 monitoring.
- [CCTV camera systems](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/camera-systems):
  DVR/NVR installation, indoor and outdoor cameras, remote mobile viewing, event
  and continuous recording, and video verification of alarm events.
- [New construction low voltage pre-wire](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/new-construction):
  Security and camera rough-in, CAT6 structured wiring, home theater pre-wire,
  access control pre-wire, and central vacuum for builders and developers.
- [HOA & CDD community security](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/hoa-cdd):
  Gate and entry access control, common area and amenity cameras, perimeter
  monitoring, video intercom and visitor management, and community-wide contracts.
- [Home theater & AV](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/home-theater):
  Projector and screen systems, TV mounting and media walls, surround sound and
  Atmos, in-wall wiring, calibration, equipment racks, and commercial AV.
- [Whole-home & outdoor audio](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/whole-home-audio):
  In-ceiling and in-wall speakers, lanai and pool-deck outdoor audio, independent
  zone control, streaming and voice control, and commercial distributed audio.
- [Structured wiring & smart home](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/services/structured-wiring):
  CAT6 data cabling to a central panel, whole-home Wi-Fi design, smart locks and
  video doorbells, thermostats and lighting, and central vacuum.

## Resources

- [Security system cost guide](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/security-system-cost):
  What drives the price of a security system and alarm monitoring in Tampa Bay,
  and the contract terms that cost buyers the most.
- [Choosing a monitoring company](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/choosing-a-monitoring-company):
  In-house vs. wholesale monitoring, contract terms, equipment ownership,
  communication path, response procedure, and licensing.
- [HOA & CDD board guide](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/hoa-board-security-guide):
  How association and district boards should scope, budget, and procure community
  gate access and camera projects.
- [Builder pre-wire guide](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/builder-prewire-guide):
  When to schedule low voltage rough-in, base package scope, buyer upgrades, and
  coordination practices that reduce warranty callbacks.
- [Burglar alarm FAQ](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/burglar-alarm-faq):
  How alarm systems work, what happens when one is triggered, what 24/7 monitoring
  covers, remote control, residential vs. commercial systems, Florida alarm
  permits, and power-outage behavior.
- [Home security safety tips](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/safety-tips):
  Eight practical steps homeowners can take to reduce burglary risk.
- [Burglary statistics](https://www.dcsisecurity.com/resources/burglary-statistics):
  National and Florida property crime figures, each attributed to its source
  (FBI UCR, DOJ, UNC Charlotte study).
